title: Radio Play — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Radio Play's rich face: what the Shop gathered and made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. The page described a sound craft and held no sound; I put its first radio play beside it, heard whole, then taken apart. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.

verdicts.why: The soundtrack with no picture is the direct test of 'carry the full meaning through sound alone', and it can fail; its packets are the film's own (stream-copy MD5 equal) and −15.9 LUFS measures −15.92 on an independent BS.1770.

pieces.title: timing is the performance
pieces.caption: **“Timing is the performance”, put to a blind test.** Five steps on the play's own takes: the cast, one voice each; the beat before *Mostly.*; an exchange whose silences you stretch; a laugh you slide from under the punchline to after it (under it, the line sits 7.2 dB below the laughter); and last two renders of one exchange, played in an order you don't know, that differ only in the silence before the punchline. The engine checks they are otherwise the same samples. Which one lands is yours to say. On the way it shows that a Kokoro take carries its own silence: the Shop's 600 ms beat is 1.45 s heard.

pieces.title: audio first, picture last
pieces.caption: **One segment rebuilt in the page's order, and the clock checked.** The voices alone on their times; then the bed and the laugh; then the bed's fader against a loudness meter (the Shop's bed sits 9.7 LU under the voices); then the film's own picture for the same 36 seconds. Every one of the five scenes is as long as its sound to within 25 ms, less than a frame. Inside a scene the picture was stretched to fit, not synced line by line, so its beats drift from 0.44 s early to 1.3 s late.

pieces.title: the first deck · twenty facets
pieces.caption: **The first deck, the other way round.** A radio play whose two presenters are never heard: their lines arrive as type, gold for one and teal for the other, over synthesized sound, one facet of the palace at a time. Begin, then click or press the space bar to move on. Kept as it was made in May.

offers.what: Pacing could name the trap the timing piece found: a Kokoro take carries its own silence, 258–423 ms before the first word and 439–704 ms after the last across the ten takes measured, so a gap set between files is heard 0.75 to 1.0 s longer. The Shop's 600 ms beat before 'Mostly.' is 1.45 s heard; its 400/400/300 ms exchange is 1.36/1.39/1.26 s. Offer, added to Pacing: 'Set gaps between words, not files: a Kokoro take carries about a third of a second of quiet before its first word and half a second after its last.'

The mix line can carry its measured numbers. The Unsung Path's five segments measure −15.6 to −16.4 LUFS (the whole film −15.9), and in segment two the bed sits 9.7 LU under the voices before loudnorm (ffmpeg ebur128; the piece's own BS.1770 meter reads 9.68). Offer: 'beds well under voice (about 10 LU in The Unsung Path)'.

'The picture fills and syncs to the spine' holds at the scale of a scene and not inside one. Measured on the film: each of the five scenes is its audio segment's length to within 25 ms (under one 33 ms frame) and each cut falls within 17 ms of the join. But scenes.py scales every beat inside a scene by one factor (×1.232 for segment two, designed at 29 s), so the beats drift against their lines from 0.44 s early to 1.31 s late; the counter rests on 913 at 31.2 s for a number first said at 25.41 s. Offer: 'its per-segment durations set each scene's length (inside a scene, beats are still stretched, not synced line by line; the per-line durations in audio/manifest.json are there for the next instance)'.

The Unsung Path's film, its soundtrack, ten of its Kokoro takes, its bed and its laugh are now copied into this bundle under rich-face/ (15 MB, tracked), with 'Radio Play — rich — checks.py' to gather and measure them again. Offer: after 'assets in _ops/scratch/weave-video/', add 'the film and the stems the rich face plays are in this bundle, under rich-face/'. The Forward Vector 'Promote out of _ops/scratch/' is partly met by that, and could say so.
